memberdef.definition: static< T > Scope< T > org.xvm.util.Scope< T >.on
memberdef.name: on

briefdescription.para: Factory Method: Entry point for scope chaining.

detaileddescription.para: Wraps a value in a Scope to enable fluent method chaining with scope functions. Equivalent to Kotlin's obj.run { ... } or obj.let { ... }.

parameterdescription.para: the value to wrap (null is allowed)

simplesect.para: a new Scope wrapping the value

memberdef.definition: static< T, R > R org.xvm.util.Scope< T >.with
memberdef.argsstring: (T value, Function<? super T, ? extends R > block)
memberdef.name: with

briefdescription.para: Factory Method: Executes a block with an object and returns the result.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to Kotlin's with(obj) { ... }. Use when you need to call multiple methods on an object and return a computed result.

parameterdescription.para: the function to execute with the object
the type of the context object

briefdescription.para: Factory Method: Executes a supplier block and returns its result.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to Kotlin's run { ... } (without a receiver). Use for computing a value from a block of code.

briefdescription.para: Scope Function: Executes the block and returns its result.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to Kotlin's obj.let { it.transform() }. Use when you want to transform the object into something else.

simplesect.para: the result of applying the block to the value

briefdescription.para: Scope Function: Executes a block and returns its result.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to Kotlin's obj.run { transform() }. Semantically identical to let, included for Kotlin API parity.

simplesect.para: the result of applying the block to the value

memberdef.definition: public< R > Optional< R > org.xvm.util.Scope< T >.letIfPresent
memberdef.name: letIfPresent

briefdescription.para: Null-Safe Variant: Executes the block only if the value is non-null.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to Kotlin's obj?.let { ... }. Returns Optional.empty() if the value is null.

simplesect.para: Optional containing the result, or empty if value is null

briefdescription.para: Scope Function: Executes a side effect block and returns the Scope for chaining.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to Kotlin's obj.also { println(it) }. Use for side effects like logging, validation, or debugging without breaking the chain.

briefdescription.para: Scope Function: Executes a configuration block and returns the Scope for chaining.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to Kotlin's Obj().apply { x = 1; y = 2 }. Use for configuring or initializing an object. Semantically identical to also, but communicates intent: apply is for configuration, also is for side effects.

preformatted.javadoccode:
StringBuilder sb = Scope.on(new StringBuilder()) .apply(b -> b.append("Hello")) .apply(b -> b.append(" ")) .apply(b -> b.append("World")) .get(); // sb.toString() = "Hello World"
HttpRequest request = Scope.on(new HttpRequest()) .apply(r -> r.setMethod("POST")) .apply(r -> r.setUrl("/api/users")) .apply(r -> r.addHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")) .get();

briefdescription.para: Null-Safe Variant: Executes the side effect block only if the value is non-null.

parameterdescription.para: the side effect consumer (only called if value is non-null)

briefdescription.para: Null-Safe Variant: Executes the configuration block only if the value is non-null.

parameterdescription.para: the configuration consumer (only called if value is non-null)

briefdescription.para: Terminal Operation: Returns the wrapped value.

detaileddescription.para: Use at the end of a chain to extract the final value. The value may be null if null was passed to on(Object).

briefdescription.para: Terminal Operation: Returns the value wrapped in an Optional.

detaileddescription.para: Use when you want to continue with Optional-style processing.

simplesect.para: Optional containing the value, or empty if null

briefdescription.para: Terminal Operation: Returns the value or throws if null.

detaileddescription.para: Use when null is not expected and should be treated as an error.

preformatted.javadoccode: Person person = Scope.on(findPerson(id)) .requireNonNull(); // throws if not found

briefdescription.para: A fluent Java utility that emulates Kotlin's scope functions: let, also, apply, run, and with.

detaileddescription.para: Based on the semantics described in the Kotlin documentation.

listitem.para: Preserve Kotlin semantics: let/run return block result, also/apply return the original object
Remain idiomatic, pure Java (no reflection, no bytecode tricks)
Lambdas cannot have implicit this or it
